| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hours` | `number` | no | — | Size of the window ending now, in hours. Default 24; capped at 744 (31 days). |
| `project_id` | `string` | no | — | Restrict to one project. Defaults to the caller's active project; omit both for every project. |
